title: visionware
features:
⚡ Main

◆ Auto Tap
◆ Auto Rebirth (Best Affordable or specific amount)
◆ Rebirth Cooldown slider
◆ Auto Breakables (normal + increased radius)
◆ Auto Hatch (1 / 3 / Max with inventory full detection)
◆ Best Egg (auto-selects highest multiplier affordable egg)
◆ Egg Teleport
◆ Skip Egg Animation

🔺 Upgrades

◆ Auto Skill Tree (chain purchasing with prerequisite handling)
◆ Auto Breakable Upgrades

🐾 Pets

◆ Auto Equip Best Pets
◆ Auto Complete Index (teleports to correct egg, sets craft targets)
◆ Auto Claim Index Rewards
◆ Index target status label with remaining count
◆ Rarity and variant filters for index completion
◆ Auto Delete from inventory (rarity + variant filters, min multiplier threshold)
◆ Pet Lookup with 3D viewport, variant selector, level slider and live stats

⚙️ Machines

◆ Auto Craft Golden (multi-select pets + amount, 1–6)
◆ Auto Craft Rainbow (multi-select pets + amount, 1–5)
◆ Rainbow queue status with live countdown
◆ Auto Claim ready Rainbow pets
◆ Auto Merchant (gem affordability + sold out detection)
◆ Auto Enchant (multi-select desired pets & enchants, tier-aware matching)
◆ Auto Bank — deposit and withdraw with rarity + variant filters

🎁 Misc

◆ Auto Claim Group + Partner Chests (cooldown aware, teleports to pad, partner check)
◆ Auto Claim Forever Pack (free slots only)
◆ Auto Buy Portals (walks Spawn → Tech chain)
◆ Auto Lucky Blocks (multi-select blocks + open amount)
◆ Auto Potions (skip if active, skip if not owned, live status)

🛠️ Quality of Life

◆ Anti AFK
◆ SaveManager config saving
◆ ThemeManager with custom themes
◆ Configurable menu keybind
◆ Safe unload with full cleanup
